title: Can't have a dash in the name of a test project

labels.name: Bug
labels.description: A fault in an existing feature

body:
It is not possible to have a test project with a dash in the name. My example below uses F#, but the problem seems to exist both for C# and F#.

To reproduce this, save the following as  `fsharp-tests.fsproj` and run `dotnet test`:
```
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net9.0</TargetFramework>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Update="FSharp.Core" Version="9.0.201" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk" Version="17.13.0" />
    <PackageReference Include="xunit.v3" Version="2.0.0" />
    <PackageReference Include="xunit.runner.visualstudio" Version="3.0.2" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
```

This will fail with the following error message:
`C:\repos\fsharp-tests\obj\Debug\net9.0\XunitAutoGeneratedEntryPoint.fs(5,1): error FS0010: Unexpected symbol '[<' in implementation file`

The cause is that the namespace of `XunitAutoGeneratedEntryPoint.fs` will have a namespace with `-` in it, which isn't allowed:
```
// <auto-generated> This file has been auto generated by xunit.v3.msbuildtasks. </auto-generated>

module internal fsharp-null-tests.AutoGenerated

[<EntryPoint>]
[<global.System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage>]
let main args =
    if Array.exists(fun arg -> arg = "--server" || arg = "--internal-msbuild-node") args then
        global.Xunit.Runner.InProc.SystemConsole.TestingPlatform.TestPlatformTestFramework.RunAsync(args, System.Action<_,_>(fun b a -> SelfRegisteredExtensions.AddSelfRegisteredExtensions(b,a))).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
    else
        global.Xunit.Runner.InProc.SystemConsole.ConsoleRunner.Run(args).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
```

The problem probably exists for other types of characters as well.
